svg.text: MediMind Clinical AI — AWS Cloud Architecture
Production-Optimized Single-Node Container Stack on AWS | Region: ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
Users enter the MediMind website domain in a web browser, and Amazon Route 53 resolves the domain name.
The web browser establishes an encrypted HTTPS connection to Amazon CloudFront to access the MediMind website.
AWS WAF inspects incoming requests against security rules while AWS Certificate Manager provisions public TLS certificates.
Amazon CloudFront serves cached website assets and forwards dynamic requests through the Internet Gateway to the Load Balancer.
The Application Load Balancer checks service health and routes requests to the Backend application running in Docker on Amazon EC2.
The Backend reads and writes application data in Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and stores ChromaDB vectors and uploads on Amazon EBS.
The Backend integrates over HTTPS with Google Gemini API, Google OAuth 2.0 & Maps, Leaflet / OpenStreetMap, and Twilio / SpeedSMS.
The Backend sends OTP verification codes and appointment confirmation emails to the User Email Inbox via Amazon SES.
GitHub Actions runs quality checks, builds and pushes the Docker image to Amazon ECR, and Amazon EC2 pulls the image to deploy.
DevOps manages Amazon EC2 via AWS Systems Manager Session Manager without SSH, using Parameter Store secrets and AWS IAM roles.
Scheduled backup tasks archive encrypted PostgreSQL database dumps and ChromaDB vector snapshots into Amazon S3.
